sources.label: Monad pinned RPC observation at block 109550480
LeverUp LVUSD design disclosure dated August 28, 2026

reserveReview.rationale: At Monad block 109550480 on 2026-10-01, the LVUSD issuer's transparency() resolved to 0x0ef8fd8f36cae470aff8b9d9bbd2e5f44fb23d51 and getAllVaults() returned one vault, 0xc69d584b3118e94b3443cc6c67076281242fa704. Its reserveToken() was USDC at 0x754704bc059f8c67012fed69bc8a327a5aafb603; the vault's USDC balance was 905,948.910803 and LVUSD totalSupply() was 1,405,949.910803. LeverUp's re-fetched documentation and August 28 design disclosure explain that trader profit and loss can cause USDC reserves and circulating LVUSD to diverge. The 500,001 LVUSD shortfall is a coverage risk, not a second reserve asset; MON collateral supports the separate LVMON token. This snapshot inventories the issuer-designated reserve vaults, not incidental tokens sent to the vault or a proof of the contracts' full liabilities.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: LeverUp documentation and a fixed-block read of the complete LVUSD issuer transparency vault list, reserve token, USDC balance, and LVUSD supply

obligations.reason: Exact totalSupply() of the tracked LVUSD contract at the same finalized block; no supply override or current USD partition is asserted.
Token supply and designated-vault assets do not establish complete pending redemptions, trader profit/loss, fees, interest or other protocol obligations.

ratio.unitBasis: USDC units per LVUSD token; designated-vault-only diagnostic, not full economic-liability coverage

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete issuer-designated LVUSD vault list contained one vault whose reserveToken() was USDC. No additional designated LVUSD reserve asset was identified. Its USDC balance was 500,001 below LVUSD supply, so the designated reserve composition is complete while reserve coverage is below 100%.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: lvUSD's USDC collateral sits inside LeverUp's protocol trading system on Monad rather than with a named legal custodian; the reviewed documentation does not establish account segregation, insolvency treatment, or collateral reuse terms, and trading gains or losses can change reserve coverage.
